description.description: Prose, not a name. Where the "why buy" case is made, including which channels a multi-channel proposal spans

full_url.description: Where the second phase fetches the Full Representation

line_items.description: The full form's line items, each as a summary. In a manifest entry, only those § 2.3 lists

offer_window.description: The window the offer holds: it does not hold before `start` or after `end`. This is the offer window, not the campaign flight

packages.description: The full form's packages, each as a summary. In a manifest entry, only those § 2.3 lists

version.description: Monotonically increasing revision number, starting at 1, held by the seller. Each version is a snapshot of the proposal's offered terms (§ 4.1.3). A version is frozen at the earliest of: the proposal's `status` leaving `draft`; a `negotiation_history[]` or `assent[]` entry naming it; a counterparty receiving it in any representation (§ 2.1). The offered terms of a frozen version MUST NOT change; a change to them creates version `n+1`. The values § 4.1.3 lists as not offered terms change without a new version
